profile_text.body:
Palantir describes itself as building software that empowers organizations to integrate their data, decisions, and operations, and uses the tagline "Foundational Software of Tomorrow. Delivered Today." The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Palo Alto. It is a public company, traded under the ticker PLTR, and files with the SEC under CIK 0001321655.

Its tracked AI product is Palantir AIP, listed in the Data & Analytics AI category. The company describes it as an enterprise AI platform with ontology-based governance, a defense and intelligence focus, and influence over high-stakes decisions.

The record also associates Palantir with a case in the District Court, D. Delaware, Haugland v. Anthropic PBC. No MCP servers are listed for the company.
